description: Every reusable primitive, in every state. Use this to iterate on the visual language before applying it to real pages.

blurbs.foundations: Surfaces, accent and status tokens. Every swatch is a live CSS variable — it follows the theme.
blurbs.typography: Inter Variable, self-hosted. Each size carries its own line-height, tracking and weight.
blurbs.buttons: Focus rings come from the global :focus-visible rule — tab through these to check consistency.
blurbs.badges: StatusBadge is the token-driven one — prefer it for anything that carries state.
blurbs.forms: Field wires label, description and error to the control. Inspect the DOM to confirm aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
blurbs.feedback: Alerts, progress and loading. Tints are low chroma — a change in paper stock, not a colored box.
blurbs.data: Metrics, tables and label/value pairs. Numbers use tabular figures so columns align.
blurbs.overlays: Dialog, tooltip and accordion. Check focus trapping and escape handling here.
blurbs.composition: How the page-level pieces sit together. This is the rhythm every page should inherit.
blurbs.dashboard: Composed command-center widgets, driven by the derived dashboard model over a fictional demo dossier.
blurbs.validation: Dossier-review building blocks: the review hero, findings grouped by domain with a calm health label and a direct "take me there" link, the "looks good" list, and the section-by-section summary.
blurbs.employment: Employment-workspace building blocks: the status selector, derived current-employer tenure, leave coverage against the trip, the employment-document summary + HR request list, and the review.
blurbs.finance: Financial-evidence building blocks: the funding-source selector, the read-only income overview, a sponsor summary card, the grouped financial-document summary + evidence-to-gather copy list, and the review.
blurbs.onboarding: Guided-flow building blocks: the step rail, the "Why do we ask this?" popover, and the generic collection editor.
blurbs.travel: Trip-planner building blocks: the overview hero, the connected journey timeline with destination cards, transport segments and the insurance coverage card.
blurbs.documents: Document-workspace building blocks: the segmented view switch, the readiness overview hero, and the document card in its template, custom and with-findings states.
